title: KJSEA 2027 Topical Revision Quiz Bank
note: Expanded source-based starter bank. Each question is assigned to one learning area. Questions are drawn from or closely adapted to the uploaded JSLH topical revision PDFs. Open-ended source exercises are not auto-marked. Kiswahili comprehension questions are based on the source passage.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The HCF of 12 and 18 is:
questions.explanation: The common factors are 1, 2, 3 and 6. The greatest is 6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The reciprocal of 4/7 is:
questions.explanation: The reciprocal is found by interchanging the numerator and denominator.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: What is the next term in the sequence 5, 10, 15, 20, …?
questions.explanation: The sequence increases by 5 each time. 20 + 5 = 25.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question: The sum of the interior angles of a triangle is:
questions.explanation: The interior angles of every triangle add up to 180°.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Which is the most polite request?
options: You must give me your pen.
Could I please borrow your pen?
questions.explanation: “Could I please…” uses a polite question form and courteous language.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Skimming is reading quickly to:
questions.explanation: Skimming helps a reader understand the general subject or main idea quickly.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: Scanning is used to:
questions.explanation: Scanning means looking through a text for a particular fact, name, date or detail.

questions.subject: English
questions.question: The past tense of “teach” is:
questions.explanation: “Teach” is an irregular verb. Its simple past form is “taught”.

questions.subject: Kiswahili
questions.question: Katika kifungu cha Kiwanda cha Peponi, ni nini kilichosababisha vifo vya samaki na wanyama wa majini?
questions.explanation: Kifungu kinaeleza kuwa majitaka na kemikali kutoka kiwandani yalielekezwa mtoni na kusababisha uchafuzi.

questions.subject: Kiswahili
questions.question: Kulingana na kifungu, ni nani waliofanya uchunguzi kuhusu maradhi ya wakazi?
questions.explanation: Wataalamu waliotumwa na serikali kuu walifanya uchunguzi na kubaini chanzo cha maradhi.

questions.subject: Kiswahili
questions.question: Kiwanda cha Peponi kiliagizwa kufanya nini baada ya uchafuzi?
options: Kusafisha mto Kingo na kuondoa uchafu
questions.explanation: Kiwanda kiliagizwa kusitisha shughuli, kusafisha mto Kingo na kuondoa uchafu.

questions.subject: Kiswahili
questions.question: Ni nahau ipi katika kifungu inayomaanisha kukubali kushindwa au kutii?
questions.explanation: “Kulisalimu amri” hutumika kuonyesha kukubali kushindwa au kujisalimisha.

questions.subject: Integrated Science
questions.question: Marion is curious about the world around her and loves exploring nature. She finds herself fascinated by the study of plants, animals and ecosystems. Which component of Integrated Science is Marion most interested in?
questions.explanation: Biology is the component concerned with living things, including plants, animals and ecosystems.

questions.subject: Integrated Science
questions.question: During a classroom experiment, Mwangi observed different substances mixing and reacting to form new compounds. He learns about acids, bases and the periodic table. Which aspect of Integrated Science is Mwangi learning about?
questions.explanation: Chemistry studies substances, their properties, composition and the changes they undergo.

questions.subject: Integrated Science
questions.question: Amani is interested in how objects move and the concept of energy. He often spends time building simple machines and studying how they work. Which field within Integrated Science is Amani exploring?
questions.explanation: Physics studies motion, forces, energy and how machines work.

questions.subject: Integrated Science
questions.question: Every morning, Mumbi uses her understanding of bacteria and hygiene to ensure her family stays healthy. She knows the importance of washing hands, safe food preparation and clean drinking water. How does Integrated Science benefit Mumbi's daily life?
options: By making her a better artist
By helping her understand health and hygiene
By making her better at sports
questions.explanation: Knowledge of microorganisms and hygiene helps people prevent infection and maintain health.

questions.subject: Social Studies
questions.question: What is one responsibility of society in protecting human rights?
questions.explanation: Society helps protect rights by reporting violations and supporting accountability and justice.

questions.subject: Social Studies
questions.question: Who played a key role in the Indian independence movement?
questions.explanation: Mahatma Gandhi was a major leader in India's independence movement.

questions.subject: Social Studies
questions.question: What is one possible effect of globalisation?
questions.explanation: Globalisation can expand trade, investment and access to markets, supporting economic growth.

questions.subject: Social Studies
questions.question: Which action best promotes respect and inclusivity among learners?
options: Encourage classmates to share their cultural backgrounds and experiences
Socialise only with people who share your views
questions.explanation: Inviting others to share their backgrounds encourages respect, understanding and inclusion.

questions.subject: Agriculture & Nutrition
questions.question: Lily is planning a garden that helps reduce surface runoff. What should she include?
questions.explanation: Water retention pits collect runoff and allow more water to soak into the soil.

questions.subject: Agriculture & Nutrition
questions.question: What can a school do to reduce rapid surface runoff from its grounds?
options: Use cover cropping such as grass
questions.explanation: Grass cover protects soil and slows water movement, reducing runoff and erosion.

questions.subject: Agriculture & Nutrition
questions.question: Which structure can help a community manage storm water in public areas?
questions.explanation: Detention basins temporarily hold storm water and reduce the rate at which it flows away.

questions.subject: Agriculture & Nutrition
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a common effect of soil pollution?
questions.explanation: Soil pollution can reduce fertility, contaminate water and harm soil organisms; increased yield is not an effect.

questions.subject: Pre-Technical Studies
questions.question: What does safety mean?
options: A situation where one avoids causing harm to oneself and others while carrying out an activity
Keeping safe only from dangerous substances
Causing harm to oneself and others
questions.explanation: Safety involves preventing harm to oneself and others during an activity.

questions.subject: Pre-Technical Studies
questions.question: Which is NOT an appropriate safety measure in a workplace?
questions.explanation: Walking barefoot exposes a worker to injuries and hazards; protective clothing helps reduce risk.

questions.subject: Pre-Technical Studies
questions.question: Which of the following is NOT an online threat?
questions.explanation: A strong password is a protective measure. Viruses, hacking and data theft are online threats.

questions.subject: Pre-Technical Studies
questions.question: Which is a physical threat to a laptop?
questions.explanation: Hardware failure is a physical or equipment-related threat to a digital device.

questions.subject: CRE
questions.question: CRE mainly helps learners to:
questions.explanation: CRE supports Christian understanding, values and responsible living.

questions.subject: CRE
questions.question: According to the biblical creation accounts, creation teaches that:
questions.explanation: The creation accounts present God as the creator of the universe and life.

questions.subject: CRE
questions.question: Stewardship means:
questions.explanation: Stewardship is responsible care and management of what has been entrusted to people.

questions.subject: CRE
questions.question: An example of caring for creation is:
questions.explanation: Planting trees helps care for the environment and living things.

questions.subject: Creative Arts & Sports
questions.question: Which of the following is a visual art activity?
questions.explanation: Drawing is a visual art activity because it creates an image using lines and forms.

questions.subject: Creative Arts & Sports
questions.question: Rhythm is the:
questions.explanation: Rhythm is the organised pattern of sounds and silences over time.

questions.subject: Creative Arts & Sports
questions.question: A role-play involves:
questions.explanation: Role-play involves taking roles and acting out a situation or event.

questions.subject: Creative Arts & Sports
questions.question: A beat is:
questions.explanation: A beat is the steady pulse that helps organise music in time.

questions.subject: Integrated Science
questions.question: In Tengecha community, science plays a crucial role in improving daily life. What is an example of how science enhances daily life in the community?
questions.explanation: Scientific knowledge can be used to design houses that withstand harsh weather and improve energy efficiency.

questions.subject: MATHEMATICS
questions.question: The place value of 7 in 3,742,105 is:
questions.explanation: The digit 7 is in the ten-thousands place.

questions.subject: MATHEMATICS
questions.question: The coefficient of y in 8y + 3 is:
questions.explanation: The coefficient is the number multiplying the variable.

questions.subject: MATHEMATICS
questions.question: Simplify 6m − 2m.
questions.explanation: Subtract like terms: 6m − 2m = 4m.

questions.subject: MATHEMATICS
questions.question: If x − 7 = 12, what is x?
questions.explanation: Add 7 to both sides to obtain x = 19.

questions.subject: ENGLISH
questions.question: A listener shows attention by:
questions.explanation: Appropriate eye contact shows attention and engagement.

questions.subject: ENGLISH
questions.question: The main purpose of turn-taking is to:
questions.explanation: Turn-taking gives participants a fair opportunity to speak.

questions.subject: ENGLISH
questions.question: The setting of a story refers to its:
questions.explanation: Setting is where and when a story takes place.

questions.subject: ENGLISH
questions.question: A synonym is a word with:
questions.explanation: Synonyms have similar meanings.

questions.subject: KISWAHILI
questions.question: Katika kifungu cha Kiwanda cha Peponi, kiwanda kilikuwa karibu na:
questions.explanation: Kifungu kinasema kiwanda kilijengwa karibu na mto Kingo.

questions.subject: KISWAHILI
questions.question: Ni nini kilichoelekezwa kwenye mto Kingo kutoka kiwandani?
questions.explanation: Kifungu kinataja majitaka na kemikali kutoka kiwandani.

questions.subject: KISWAHILI
questions.question: Ni taasisi gani iliyotajwa katika kifungu kuhusu usimamizi wa mazingira?
questions.explanation: Kifungu kinataja Mamlaka ya Kitaifa ya Usimamizi wa Mazingira (NEMA).

questions.subject: KISWAHILI
questions.question: Kiwanda kiliamrishwa kufanya nini baada ya uchunguzi?
questions.explanation: Kiwanda kiliagizwa kusafisha mto na kuondoa uchafu.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
questions.question: Which branch of science studies matter, its properties and changes?
questions.explanation: Chemistry studies substances, their properties and the changes they undergo.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
questions.question: Which branch studies forces, motion and energy?
questions.explanation: Physics includes the study of forces, motion and energy.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
questions.question: The study of plants and animals belongs mainly to:
questions.explanation: Biology is the study of living organisms.

questions.subject: INTEGRATED SCIENCE
questions.question: Which practice helps reduce the spread of disease?
options: washing hands with clean water and soap
questions.explanation: Handwashing helps remove disease-causing microorganisms.

questions.subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
questions.question: Which action helps protect human rights in society?
questions.explanation: Reporting violations and accountability help protect rights.

questions.subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
questions.question: Globalisation can increase:
questions.explanation: Globalisation connects countries through trade, communication and exchange.

questions.subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
questions.question: Which action demonstrates respect for cultural diversity?
questions.explanation: Respectful listening supports inclusion and understanding.

questions.subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
questions.question: Mahatma Gandhi is associated with the independence movement of:
questions.explanation: Gandhi was a prominent leader in India's independence movement.

questions.subject: AGRICULTURE & NUTRITION
questions.question: Which material is a common cause of soil pollution?
questions.explanation: Plastic waste can contaminate soil.

questions.subject: AGRICULTURE & NUTRITION
questions.question: Which practice helps prevent contamination from industrial waste?
questions.explanation: Industrial waste should be treated and disposed of properly.

questions.subject: AGRICULTURE & NUTRITION
questions.question: Which is NOT a common effect of soil pollution?
questions.explanation: Soil pollution generally harms soil quality rather than increasing yields.

questions.subject: AGRICULTURE & NUTRITION
questions.question: Which practice helps reduce surface runoff in a garden?
questions.explanation: Cover crops slow runoff and protect the soil surface.

questions.subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
questions.question: Safety means:
options: avoiding harm to oneself and others during an activity
questions.explanation: Safety involves preventing harm to oneself and others.

questions.subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
questions.question: Which item is suitable personal protective equipment when handling dusty materials?
questions.explanation: A face mask helps reduce inhalation of dust.

questions.subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
questions.question: Which of the following is a protective online practice?
questions.explanation: A strong password helps protect accounts.

questions.subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
questions.question: Which is a physical threat to a laptop?
questions.explanation: Hardware failure affects the physical device or its components.

questions.subject: CRE
questions.question: According to the biblical creation accounts, who is presented as the creator?
questions.explanation: The Genesis creation accounts present God as creator.

questions.subject: CRE
questions.question: Stewardship means:
options: wasting what is entrusted to us
questions.explanation: Stewardship is responsible care and management.

questions.subject: CRE
questions.question: The Bible is divided into:
questions.explanation: The Bible consists of the Old Testament and the New Testament.

questions.subject: CRE
questions.question: The first five books of the Bible are commonly called:
questions.explanation: The first five books are known as the Pentateuch.

questions.subject: CREATIVE ARTS & SPORTS
questions.question: The traditional primary colours in painting are:
questions.explanation: Traditional painting instruction identifies red, yellow and blue as primary colours.

questions.subject: CREATIVE ARTS & SPORTS
questions.question: Texture in visual art refers to:
options: the surface quality of an object
the size of the frame only
questions.explanation: Texture describes how a surface looks or feels.

questions.subject: CREATIVE ARTS & SPORTS
questions.question: A warm-up before physical activity helps to:
questions.explanation: A warm-up prepares muscles and the body for activity.

questions.subject: CREATIVE ARTS & SPORTS
questions.question: Fair play includes:
questions.explanation: Fair play involves honesty, respect and following agreed rules.
